messages:
neha: heads up — eval-runner started emitting duplicate examples for model-admit-2026 during the orchestration window ~1890123400-1890123600, metrics look inflated and queues spiked :grimacing:
omar: on it. do we have a reproducer or logs?
neha: minimal logs attached below, but quick summary: shard reassignment + inflight retry produced duplicate dispatch to the same worker id. payload_id repeated. example:
```
2026-03-20T21:10:12Z INFO dispatch: payload_id=abc123 shard=7 -> worker=w-12
2026-03-20T21:10:13Z WARN  lease-reassign: shard=7 from w-12 to w-9 (grace=2s)
2026-03-20T21:10:13Z INFO retry-dispatch: payload_id=abc123 shard=7 -> worker=w-9
```
neha: result: eval harness processed same example twice; aggregator dedupe was per-run not global so metrics counted twice. queue length jumped from ~40 to ~120 in 30s.
li: ouch. looks like lease-reassign triggers a resend but we don't mark inflight as acknowledged until worker ack. race window obvious.
sanjay: is there a quick mitigation? revert change? turn off lease reassignment?
omar: mitigation plan: 1) pause automated shard reassigns (eng-infra toggle), 2) enable global payload dedupe index for current run (fast path), 3) rollback the new backoff/jitter commit I merged earlier (PR #482).
michael: I can flip the infra toggle and deploy the dedupe index patch to staging. will need 10-15m.
ci-bot: deploy started: dedupe-index/patch -> staging (build 482-b).
neha: also need to update metric calculations to be idempotent — add unique-example-count and duplicate-count so dashboards surface regression instead of hiding it.
li: noted. I'll add new prometheus labels: eval_run, example_hash, dedupe_status.
omar: question for oncall: did this cause any customer-facing regressions? ops-bot: alert: model-runner-latency SLO breached for 14m during surge; no 5xx spike to external api; no active customer incidents reported.
sanjay: good. postmortem checklist: root cause, short-term mitigation, long-term fix (idempotent aggregator + lease handshake), dashboard changes, CI test for duplicate-scenario.
michael: adding tests: simulate lease reassign + in-flight retry in harness CI (fake worker acks). Will wire into nightly.
neha: thanks all — will assemble a short incident note and assign owners. tagging @omar @li for fixes. :thumbsup:
omar: assigning: tracker ticket ML-1129 (owner: li) for aggregator idempotency; ML-1130 (owner: michael) for CI test; infra ticket INF-789 for reassignment toggle.
neha: posting incident note in #incidents after we confirm staging patch passes.
ci-bot: deploy succeeded: dedupe-index/patch -> staging (build 482-b) (12:39 UTC)
michael: staging looks clean, dedupe prevented duplicates in local replay. planning prod deploy in 30m unless objections.
li: prepping tests and metric changes now.
ops-bot: prod deploy scheduled +30m (can cancel).
neha: no objections, proceed. keep updates short in this thread.
